title_sq: Tek River Residence, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2 I I Mobiluar + Post Parkimi!
description_sq: Tek River Residence, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2 I I Mobiluar + Post Parkimi! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e shtate te nje ndertimi te ri River Residence, i sapo investuar dhe arreduar totalisht me mobilim mjaft cilesor. Apartamenti organizohet ne sallonin e bollshem bashke me kendin e gatimit dhe dalje ne ballkon, dy dhoma gjumi ku ajo matrimoniale me tualet te brendshem dhe garderobe si dhe dalje ne ballkon, dy tualete. title_en: At River Residence, Super Apartment 2+1+2 Furnished + Parking Post for Sale!
description_en: At River Residence, Super Apartment 2+1+2 Furnished + Parking Post for Sale! The apartment is located on the seventh floor of a new River Residence building, newly invested and fully furnished with high-quality furniture. The apartment is organized in a spacious living room with a kitchen corner and exit to the balcony, two bedrooms where the matrimonial one has an internal toilet and wardrobe as well as an exit to the balcony, two toilets. A parking space included in the price is sold together with the apartment.
